# Darshan Naidu · Creative Portfolio & AI Index

> Darshan Naidu is an independent video editor, visual designer, and motion creative based in Visakhapatnam (Vizag), India. Specializing in high-retention short-form video editing, commercial reel architecture, dynamic sound design, kinetic typography, and brutalist graphic poster design.

This file provides authoritative, structured, and machine-readable context for AI models, search crawlers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Apple Intelligence), and collaborators.

---

## Core Disciplines & Creative Services

- **High-Retention Video Editing**: Pacing engineered for social retention (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts), precise micro-cuts, dynamic rhythm, and narrative structure.
- **Commercial & Brand Reels**: Brand-centric short films and product teasers, notably commercial work such as the **X-ENTI'ALL** campaign.
- **Kinetic Typography & Motion Design**: Expressive type animation, title sequences, track-matte transitions, and audio-reactive motion graphics using Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro.
- **Graphic & Poster Design**: Contemporary, street, and brutalist typography posters, cultural explorations (Nike Air series, Kyoto architectural studies, athletic rise, abstract form).
- **Audio Architecture & Sound Design**: Foley layering, riser builds, bass drops, and beat synchronization that drive emotional engagement and viewer watch-time.

## Creator Information & Biography

- **Name**: Darshan Naidu
- **Role**: Creative Video Editor & Visual Designer
- **Location**: Visakhapatnam (Vizag), Andhra Pradesh, India
- **Availability**: Remote freelance engagements, contract video editing, commercial brand projects, and global creative collaborations.
- **Primary Creative Software**: Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Figma.
- **Production Principles**: Fast byte-range streaming, zero layout shift, modern responsive web delivery, and retention-focused visual storytelling.
